quickActions.name: Divine Shield
quickActions.text: This creature gains +5 to all defenses until the start of its next turn.

attacks.text: 18/33/48 necrotic damage. The target's maximum HP is reduced by the damage dealt until they finish a long rest. If this reduces their max HP to 0, they die and their soul is absorbed.

attacks.name: Annihilation Ray
attacks.text: 24/44/64 force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 HP, the target is disintegrated and cannot be restored except by true resurrection or wish.

abilities.name: Undead Nature
abilities.text: This creature is immune to bleeding, being charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, or falling unconscious.

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance
abilities.text: If this creature fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance

abilities.name: Phylactery Network
abilities.text: This creature has multiple phylacteries across the world. It can only be permanently destroyed if all are found and destroyed.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.text: This creature can cast the following spells rolling Mind + Arcana once per scene each (and can cast any three again after each life pool is lost): *Counterspell*, *Dimension Door*, *Disintegrate*, *Dominate Monster*, *Finger of Death*, *Globe of Invulnerability*, *Meteor Swarm*, *Power Word Kill*, *Prismatic Wall*, *Time Stop*, *Wish*.

abilities.name: Transcendent Undeath
abilities.text: When this creature loses a life pool, choose one: (1) All creatures within medium range must save vs. TN 16 or be paralyzed for a short duration while this creature drains their life essence, healing 30 HP; (2) This creature casts Time Stop without using a spell slot; (3) This creature summons 1d6 wights and 2d6 wraiths.

quickActions.name: Greater Shield
quickActions.text: This creature can cast a powerful magical shield, gaining +6 Dodge until the start of its next turn.

quickActions.name: Counterspell
quickActions.text: This creature can attempt to interrupt a spell being cast within medium range.

quickActions.name: Teleport
quickActions.text: This creature teleports up to long range to an unoccupied space it can see.
